verses.en: Whoso loveth instruction loveth knowledge: but he that hateth reproof is brutish.
verses.sm: O le ua fiafia ina a'oa'oina, ua fiafia o ia i le poto; a o le ‘ino‘ino i le aoaiga, o le vale lea.

verses.en: A good man obtaineth favour of the LORD: but a man of wicked devices will he condemn.
verses.sm: O le tagata amio lelei, e maua e ia le alofa mai le Aw; a o le tagata ua fai togafiti leaga, e faasalaina lea.

verses.en: A man shall not be established by wickedness: but the root of the righteous shall not be moved.
verses.sm: E le faatumauina le tagata i le amio leaga; a o le pogai o e amiotonu, e le faagaeetia lea.

verses.en: A virtuous woman is a crown to her husband: but she that maketh ashamed is as rottenness in his bones.
verses.sm: O le ava amio lelei, o le pale lea i lana tane; a o lē faami, e tusa o ia ma le mea e pala ai ona ivi.

verses.en: The thoughts of the righteous are right: but the counsels of the wicked are deceit.
verses.sm: O mafaufauga a e amiotonu, ua tonu ia; o pulega a e amio leaga, ua pepelo ia.

verses.en: The words of the wicked are to lie in wait for blood: but the mouth of the upright shall deliver them.
verses.sm: O upu a e amio leaga e lamalama 11e toto; a o gutu o e ua sao a latou amio, e laveaiina ai i latou.

verses.en: The wicked are overthrown, and are not: but the house of the righteous shall stand.
verses.sm: Ua faaumatia E amio leaga, ua leai lava i latou; a o le fale o e amiotonu, e tumau lava lea.

verses.en: A man shall be commended according to his wisdom: but he that is of a perverse heart shall be despised.
verses.sm: E viia le tagata, e tusa ma lona poto; a o le ua loto faapiopio, e inocia lava o ia.

verses.en: He that is despised, and hath a servant, is better than he that honoureth himself, and lacketh bread.
verses.sm: E lelei lē ua ta‘ufaatauvaaina, a e fai lona tautua; a e leaga le na te vivii o ia ia te ia, a e fia “ai.

verses.en: A righteous man regardeth the life of his beast: but the tender mercies of the wicked are cruel.
verses.sm: Ua faapelepele le tagata amiotonu i lana manu; a o le alofa o e amio leaga, o le sauaga lea.

verses.en: He that tilleth his land shall be satisfied with bread: but he that followeth vain persons is void of understanding.
verses.sm: O lē galue i lona fanua, e ma'ona o ia i mea e ‘ai; a o le mulimuli i tagata faatauvaa, ua leai sona mafaufau.

verses.en: The wicked desireth the net of evil men: but the root of the righteous yieldeth fruit.
verses.sm: E manao lē amio leaga i mea ua maua e tagata amio leaga; a o le pogai o e amiotonu, e fua mai lea.

verses.en: The wicked is snared by the transgression of his lips: but the just shall come out of trouble.
verses.sm: Oa i ai le mailei leaga i le solitulafono o laugutu; a e sao lē amiotonu ai le puapuaga.

verses.en: A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of his mouth: and the recompence of a man's hands shall be rendered unto him.
verses.sm: E ma'ona le tagata i mea lelei ai le fua o lona gutu; e taui atu foi i le tagata o mea na faia e ona lima.

verses.en: The way of a fool is right in his own eyes: but he that hearkeneth unto counsel is wise.
verses.sm: O le ala o le vale, ua tonu lea i lona manatu; a o le ua faalogo i le pule, e poto ia.

verses.en: A fool's wrath is presently known: but a prudent man covereth shame.
verses.sm: E vave iloa le ita o le vale; a o le tagata mafaufau, ua ufiufi e ia lona mā.

verses.en: He that speaketh truth sheweth forth righteousness: but a false witness deceit.
verses.sm: O lē tautala faamaoni, ua faaali mai e ia le tonu; a O le molimau pepelo, ua faaali mai e ia le faa‘ole‘ole.

verses.en: There is that speaketh like the piercings of a sword: but the tongue of the wise is health.
verses.sm: O i ai lé soona tautala, e pei o tutuʻii le pelu; a o laulaufaiva o e popoto e malolo ai.

verses.en: The lip of truth shall be established for ever: but a lying tongue is but for a moment.
verses.sm: O laugutu faamaoni, e faatumauina ia e faavavau; a o le laulaufaiva pepelo, ua se emo o le mata lea.

verses.en: Deceit is in the heart of them that imagine evil: but to the counsellors of peace is joy.
verses.sm: O le faaʻoleʻole, ua i ai lea i loto o e fai togafiti leaga; a o e pule ia filemu, e i ai le olioli.

verses.en: There shall no evil happen to the just: but the wicked shall be filled with mischief.
verses.sm: E le oo se mea leaga e tasi i lé amiotonu; a o e amio leaga, e tutumu i latou i le leaga.

verses.en: Lying lips are abomination to the LORD: but they that deal truly are his delight.
verses.sm: E inosia e le ALII o laugutu pepelo; a o e fai mea faamaoni, e fiafia i ai o ia.

verses.en: A prudent man concealeth knowledge: but the heart of fools proclaimeth foolishness.
verses.sm: O le tagata mafaufau, na te ufiufi lona poto; a o loto o e valelea e faalauaitele lo latou valea.

verses.en: The hand of the diligent shall bear rule: but the slothful shall be under tribute.
verses.sm: E manumalo lima o e filigä i galuega; a o lē paie, e fai taulaga o ia.

verses.en: Heaviness in the heart of man maketh it stoop: but a good word maketh it glad.
verses.sm: O le atuatuvale i le loto o le tagata ua faavaivai ai o ia; a o le upu lelei e faaolioliina ai.

verses.en: The righteous is more excellent than his neighbour: but the way of the wicked seduceth them.
verses.sm: O le tagata amiotonu, na te faaali le ala i lana uo; a o le ala o e amio leaga, e faaseseina ai i latou.

verses.en: The slothful man roasteth not that which he took in hunting: but the substance of a diligent man is precious.
verses.sm: E le tunua e le paie lana manu sa tuli; a o le oloa tāua a tagata, e i ai lea i le ua filigā i galuega.

verses.en: In the way of righteousness is life; and in the pathway thereof there is no death.
verses.sm: O le ala o le amiotonu, o i ai le ola; e leai foi se oti i ona magaala.
